cor_func <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    corrr::correlate()%>%
    gather(time_point, cor, -term)%>%
    mutate(cor = replace(cor, duplicated(cor), NA))%>%
    drop_na(cor)
}

library(coda)

estimate_mode <- function(s) {
  d <- density(s)
  return(d$x[which.max(d$y)])
}

hdi_upper<- function(s){
  m <- HPDinterval(mcmc(s))
  return(m["var1","upper"])
}

hdi_lower<- function(s){
  m <- HPDinterval(mcmc(s))
  return(m["var1","lower"])
}

```{r }

# Combine datasets from two waves
# --> Restructure_data.R --> saves combined long-format dataset in file "laac_complete.txt"
#long <- read.csv("laac_complete.txt", sep="", na.strings="-99")

long <- read.csv("../data/laac_complete.txt", sep="", na.strings="-99")

# create categorical variables indicating time point and stable trait level
long$trial <- as.factor(long$trial)
long$time_cat <- as.factor(long$time_point)
long$trait <- 1
# recode search task to binary response
long[long$task == "search", "code"] <- car::recode(long[long$task == "search", "code"], '2=1')

long_bin <- long%>%
  filter(!is.na(code))%>%
  group_by(time_point, subject, task, time_cat, trait)%>%
  summarise(n = length(code), 
            sum = sum(code))%>%
  ungroup()

long_bin_all <- long_bin%>%
  mutate(phase = ifelse(task %in% c("cause", "delay", "gaze", "inference", "quant"), 1, 2))%>%
  mutate(time_point = ifelse(phase == 1, time_point - 4, time_point))%>%
  filter(time_point > 0)%>%
  mutate(time_cat = as.factor(time_point))

for (i in unique(long_bin_all$task)) {
  
  long_bin_all%>%filter(task == i)%>%write_csv(paste0("../data/data_",i,".csv"))
  
}

```

# Search patterns self-ordered search

```{r}
search_dat_ind <- read_csv("../data/inhibit_searched_data.csv")%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(search_pattern = paste0(search_1, search_2, search_3))%>%
  group_by(subject, group,time_point, search_pattern)%>%
  summarise(freq = n())%>%
  group_by(subject, time_point)%>%
  mutate(prop_dominant = freq/sum(freq))%>%
  group_by(subject, time_point)%>%
  filter(prop_dominant == max(prop_dominant))


search_dat_agg <- search_dat_ind%>%
  group_by(time_point)%>%
  tidyboot_mean(column = prop_dominant)

ggplot()+
  geom_point(data =search_dat_ind, aes(x = factor(time_point), y = prop_dominant), alpha = 0.1)+
  geom_line(data =search_dat_ind, aes(x = factor(time_point), y = prop_dominant, group = subject), alpha = 0.1)+
  #geom_point(data =search_dat_agg, aes(x = time_point, y = mean), col = "firebrick")+
  geom_pointrange(data =search_dat_agg, aes(x = time_point, y = mean, ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper), col = "firebrick")+
  labs(x = "Time point", y = "Proportion most dominant search pattern")+
  geom_line(data =search_dat_agg, aes(x = time_point, y = mean), col = "firebrick")+
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
search_dat_agg_pat <- read_csv("../data/inhibit_searched_data.csv")%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(search_pattern = paste0(search_1, search_2, search_3))%>%
  group_by(time_point, search_pattern)%>%
  summarise(n = n())%>%
  group_by(time_point)%>%
  mutate(sum = sum(n))%>%
  rowwise()%>%
  mutate(prop = n/sum)

search_dat_agg_pat%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = search_pattern, y = prop))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity")+
  facet_grid(time_point~.)+
  theme_bw()

search_dat_agg_pat%>%
  filter(search_pattern %in% c("123", "132", "213", "231", "312", "321"))%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(time_point), y = prop, col = search_pattern))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(aes(group = search_pattern))+
  labs(x = "Time point", y = "Proportion strategy")+
  scale_color_colorblind()+
  theme_bw()
```

# Correlated slopes

```{r}

data_ind <- data_trial%>%
  group_by(task, subject, time_point)%>%
  summarise(sum = sum(code), 
            n = n())%>%
  mutate(id = paste(task, subject, sep = "_"))

# reference model 
  bmr <-  brm(sum|trials(n) ~ time_point,
                 data = data_ind%>% filter(id == "Attention-following_abeeku"),
                 family = binomial(),
                 chains = 3,
                 cores = 3,
                 iter=2000)



ind_slopes <- tibble()

for (i in unique(data_ind$id)) {
    
 dx <- data_ind%>%filter(id == i)

 bmij <- update(bmr, newdata = data_ind)
 
 x <- fixef(bmi)%>%as_tibble(rownames = "param")%>%filter(param == "time_point")%>%mutate(id = i)

 ind_slopes <- bind_rows(ind_slopes, x)   
 
 saveRDS(ind_slopes, "../saves/id_slopes.rds")
  
}

```
